FROM golang:1.23-alpine AS build — give this stage a name so you can reference it in the second stage
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build produces a statically linked binary — required for distroless which has no C library
FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot as your final stage, then COPY --from=build /app /app — after kind load, annotate the deployment with dojo.docker/build-type=multi-stage
